evaluation_type: One-shot forward smoke trials against existing first-case rubrics

scope.case_selection: Only the first case in each existing cases.json

limitations: These are one-shot smoke trials, not blind comparisons or proof of general skill quality.
Only six positive first cases ran. No unexecuted cases or nontrigger/activation cases are scored.
The trials explicitly loaded candidate skill snapshots and therefore do not establish automatic activation accuracy.
Capability constraints were instructions, not technically disabled permissions. No prohibited use was observed in the supplied tools.md records; those logs are not full independent traces.
Scores reflect answer content against the fixed rubrics. Verbosity itself earns no credit.
No runtime validation pass is inferred. Proposed checks and fixture-reported results remain unexecuted or unverified unless the tool log explicitly records otherwise.
Model, generation settings, token usage, and elapsed execution metrics were unavailable and are recorded as null.
